L14@P0: Cemiplimab Therapy
L15@P0: INDICATIONS FOR USE:
L16@P0: INDICATION ICD10
L17@P0: Regimen
L18@P0: Code
L19@P0: HSE approved
L20@P0: reimbursement
L21@P0: Status*
L22@P0: As monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with recurrent or
L23@P0: metastatic cervical cancer and disease progression on or after platinumbased chemotherapy
L24@P0: C53 00812a N/A
L25@P0: As monotherapy is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with
L26@P0: metastatic or locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (mCSCC
L27@P0: or laCSCC) who are not candidates for curative surgery or curative radiation
L28@P0: C44 00812b ODMS
L29@P0: 1/10/2024
L30@P0: * This is for post 2012 indications only.
L31@P0: TREATMENT:
L32@P0: The starting dose of the drugs detailed below may be adjusted downward by the prescribing clinician, using their
L33@P0: independent medical judgement, to consider each patients individual clinical circumstances.
L34@P0: Cemiplimab is administered on day 1 of a 21 day cycle and continued until disease progression or
L35@P0: unacceptable toxicity occurs.
L36@P0: Facilities to treat anaphylaxis MUST be present when systemic anti-cancer therapy (SACT) is administered.
L37@P0: Day Drug Dose Route Diluent & Rate Cycle
L38@P0: 1 Cemiplimab 350mg IV infusion a50mL NaCl 0.9% over 30 minutes Every 21 days
L39@P0: Cemiplimab should be administered through an intravenous line containing a sterile, non-pyrogenic, low-protein binding, inline or add-on filter (0.2 micron to 5 micron pore size).
L40@P0: Other medicinal products should not be co-administered through the same infusion line.
L41@P0: a Cemiplimab is diluted to a final concentration ranging from 1mg/mL to 20mg/mL
L42@P0:  Note: Administration volumes and fluids have been standardised to facilitate electronic prescribing system builds.
L43@P0: ELIGIBILITY:
L44@P0:  Indications as above
L45@P0:  ECOG 0-2
L46@P0:  Adequate renal, hepatic and haematological function
L47@P0:  Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma indication:
L48@P0: o At least 1 measurable lesion
L49@P0: CAUTIONS:
L50@P0:  Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma indication:
L51@P0-1: o Patients who have received solid organ transplantNCCP National SACT Regimen

L65@P1: EXCLUSIONS:
L66@P1:  Hypersensitivity to cemiplimab or any of the excipients
L67@P1:  Immunosuppressive doses of systemic corticosteroids or other immunosuppressive
L68@P1: medication(s) (defined as >10mg predniSOLONE/daily (or steroid equivalent, excluding inhaled
L69@P1: or topical steroids)
L70@P1:  Any active clinically significant infection requiring therapy
L71@P1:  Active CNS metastases
L72@P1:  Information regarding prior therapy with an anti PD-1 or anti PD-L1 antibody is available here
L73@P1:  Pregnancy/breastfeeding
L74@P1: PRESCRIPTIVE AUTHORITY:
L75@P1:  The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist
L76@P1: TESTS:
L77@P1: Baseline tests:
L78@P1:  FBC, renal and liver profile
L79@P1:  Blood glucose
L80@P1:  Thyroid function tests
L81@P1:  Virology Screen: Hepatitis B (HBsAg, HBcoreAb) and Hepatitis C
L82@P1: Regular tests:
L83@P1:  FBC, renal and liver profile prior to each cycle
L84@P1:  Blood glucose prior to each cycle
L85@P1:  TSH every 3 to 6 weeks
L86@P1: Disease monitoring:
L87@P1: Disease monitoring should be in line with the patient’s treatment plan and any other test/s as
L88@P1: directed by the supervising Consultant.
L89@P1: DOSE MODIFICATIONS:
L90@P1:  No dose reductions are recommended.
L91@P1:  Dosing delay or discontinuation may be required based on individual safety and tolerability.
L92@P1-2:  Recommended modifications to manage adverse reactions are provided in Table 1. NCCP National SACT Regimen
